what: [ci] 106 of 149 workflows trigger on `issues: [opened]`; every opened issue (diag relay, system-action, prop report) creates up to 106 runs, ~98% skipped (100 most recent event=issues runs: 98 skipped, 2 success; >=2,500 in ~33h). Cost is run-list noise that buries scheduled runs, not runner minutes; a link to the 08-27 scheduler lag is NOT established. Proposal: one `issue-router.yml` on issues:opened that maps label -> workflow and calls workflow_dispatch (GITHUB_TOKEN may dispatch), then drop the issues trigger from each routed workflow, migrating relay workflows in batches so the Claude-on-the-web issue path keeps working.
